authority: #K2-411 sec.2: the remaining DROP-NAMED gaps go to the DEVIATION channel (engineering layer first; owner only if requirements/interfaces are touched).
layer: ENDPOINT/PORT layer (maze snap) - NOT capacity (93.5% free), NOT the criteria, NOT the placement gate.
why_the_current_means_cannot_close_them: the maze's snap_node requires a FREE cell that is IN the endpoint's own net island within maxr; for these eight endpoints no such cell exists (the cells are pruned by foreign copper and/or lie outside the frame).
a direct stitch is FORBIDDEN (#K2-411) and was measured unsafe (R1146: 35 shorts / 25 crossings / 40 mask bridges).
the port-aware goal patch is already active on this chain (the wrapper installs it when --bound-rect is set) and still leaves these eight.

engineering_layer_dispositions.what: ENDPOINT-OWN-CELL SEMANTIC FIX (proposed): the point being snapped lies ON the net's own copper, so its own cell is BY DEFINITION a legal start/goal - extend the wrapper's snap relaxation from 'port points' to 'the endpoint's own point' (a semantics fix, not a new tool), and let the final DRC adjudicate the emitted segment.
engineering_layer_dispositions.why_it_is_principled: it does not weaken any clearance rule: the connection still terminates on the net's own copper, and any resulting clearance violation is still caught by the final DRC (and would be REFUSED/attributed).
engineering_layer_dispositions.expected: may unblock several of the eight; any that still fail remain named.

engineering_layer_dispositions.what: IN-DOMAIN RE-ROUTE for the four frame-spanning pairs (PERSTA# / P3V3_AUX / I2C1_SDA / P3V3): their two fragments are separated across the frame; their connectivity must be re-derived INSIDE the domain (C38-class), i.e. the maze must be given a legal in-frame goal on the same net.

BOUNDED DEVIATION (fallback): if D1+D2 still leave gaps, accept them as a DOCUMENTED BOUNDED DEVIATION for this exam only, with the four-question certificate (already filed) - NOT as a criteria change.

not_an_owner_matter_yet: no requirement/interface is touched; all three dispositions are engineering-layer.
recommended_order: D2 (in-domain re-route for the span pairs)
